sources.finding: Intermediate next-character losses improved optimization in a deep untied character-level transformer. Its recipe also changes other training details and decays intermediate supervision;it does not establish a result for our shared probability replay.
sources.local_hypothesis: An explicitly supervised early prediction could shorten the measured optimization lag and make shallow/deep exits interpretable. This is a new hypothesis,not a diagnosed bug or admitted intervention. Source-target weighting would have to remain uniform and all added work counted.

sources.finding: PonderLM-3 reports70Mmodels on15Btokens and410Mmodels on10Btokens,using Jacobi-aligned latent states,differentiable routing and a stopping penalty. Main resource curves compare inference work. This contradicts a universal billion-parameter floor but does not give our200M-target screen a matched-training-work success.
sources.local_implication: Separate learning age,optimization,mechanism and resource claims. Do not copy the router before fixed useful work exists,or reinterpret inference-budget results as training efficiency.

scope: Research context only. Finish the frozen untied comparison and source-separated structural readout first.
